headline: ICICI Prudential MF's S Naren advises against chasing US stocks and recommends international debt
hook: S Naren warns against chasing US rallies
summary: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund CIO S Naren cautioned investors at the ET Wealth Expo against chasing asset classes following sharp rallies, labeling the practice as anti-asset allocation. He advised investors to focus on underperforming asset classes such as international debt and utilize valuation metrics to steer investment decisions. Naren also shared perspectives on gold, real estate, and the necessity of maintaining patience during market corrections. Indian retail investors are affected as they increasingly look toward global diversification and international mutual fund routes for their portfolios.
why_it_matters: Reconsider asset allocation before adding US equities to portfolios.
